questions.subject: GRAPHIC_DESIGN
questions.learningObjective: evaluate columns and gutters in a design critique
questions.stem: On Columns and gutters: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that text columns run together with no space between them. What structural element is missing from this layout?

options.text: A gutter, which is the space separating adjacent columns
A baseline, the invisible line that text sits upon
options.misconception: confuses vertical rhythm with the separation of columns

options.text: A bleed, the area that extends beyond the trim line
options.misconception: mistakes a print margin for the gap between columns

options.text: A measure, the width of one line of text within a column
options.misconception: names the line length rather than the gap between columns

questions.explanation: In a column grid the gutter is the channel of space between adjacent columns. Without it, text from neighboring columns visually merges, so the gutter is essential for separating the columns while still relating them as part of one system.
questions.hint: What is the empty channel between two columns called?
